summary: Challenge to Madras High Court directions in PILs concerning Formula 4 racing in Chennai; directions on reimbursement of Rs 42 crores, future deposits of Rs 15 crores, and state responsibility for event conduct impugned; MoU between RPPL and SDAT outlined with financial obligations; state's facilitative role acknowledged, private entity to bear event costs; High Court interference with MoU terms deemed impermissible; directions set aside to uphold contractual autonomy and policy promotion of motorsports.
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; impugned directions in High Court order set aside; MoU to be implemented as per its terms.
